svg.title: Groundskeeper system architecture
svg.desc: The deployed demo web app connects through Next.js and Prisma to a pending live PostgreSQL database. Separate webhook ingress and leased workers analyze pinned GitHub snapshots. Explicit operator commands verify examples with Docker and publish approved draft repairs.
